title: feat(3d): 3D Adaptive gets a Method choice with a Trochoidal method per level
body:
Stacked on #2149 (merge #2149 first)

## What changed

3D Pocket has a new parameter, **Method**, with the values Spiral and Trochoidal.
The Adaptive strategy reads it. The other strategies do not read it.
The default is Spiral. A Spiral operation cuts the same path and has the same stamp as before.

With Method = Trochoidal, each level of the plain ladder is cleared by trochoidal loops.
The loops are planned by the 2D Adaptive lane planner on the cutter-centre area of that level.
The ladder already makes this area: the footprint less the part above the plane, less the tool radius and the stock to leave.

- `crates/motion/src/machining2d/adaptive_troch_level.rs` (new) plans, posts and checks one level.
- `crates/motion/src/machining3d/troch.rs` (new) holds the state of one run and the entry point `pocket3d_trochoidal`.
- `ladder` gets a `method` argument and four short hooks.
- `OpParams::Pocket3D` gets the field `method`. The project file writes it as the word `method` (`spiral` or `trochoidal`). A file without the word reads as Spiral.
- The stamp gets one byte only for Adaptive with Trochoidal.
- The Passes tab of 3D Pocket shows a Method row when Strategy is Adaptive.
- MCP: `edit_operation` and `add_operation` accept `"method"` in `params`. No new tool is necessary, because the method is a field of the existing parameters.
- The guide page `operations-3d.md` has one new table row and one new paragraph.

Rules of a trochoidal level:

- Each cutting move stays in the level area. The posted level is checked move by move.
- The posted level is checked against the crossing law: its own moves and all moves before it.
- A bore starts on a plane only if the run proved that plane cleared below the disc of the bore helix. If not, the bore starts one plunge height above the stock top.
- A level that the method cannot cut is cut by the Spiral plan. A note gives the reason and the Z of the level. The refused attempt posts nothing.
- In a trochoidal run, each level enters as a first level does. No level reads the plane above as cleared.
- The rest pass, the offset shells and the rotary wrap keep the plan that they had. Their existing notes say so.

## UI screenshots

These images show the real 3D Pocket Passes tab under `Strategy = Adaptive` on a 60 x 40 x 20 mm pocket block (`1440 x 960`, software/headless WGPU render).
The before capture removes only the new `Method` row and its `Trochoidal` hint arm in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/mill3d_page.rs`.
The after captures show the `Method` combo (`Spiral` default and `Trochoidal`) and the `Trochoidal` hover hint on the `Method` label.
The screenshots live only on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch at `871b8c1fec9376b3eb26d8af94a86fc4f325e7ee`.

| Before | After (`Method = Spiral`, default) | After (`Method = Trochoidal`, hint shown) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ![Before: 3D Pocket Passes tab under Adaptive without Method row](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/871b8c1fec9376b3eb26d8af94a86fc4f325e7ee/2704/before.png) | ![After: 3D Pocket Passes tab under Adaptive with Method set to Spiral](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/871b8c1fec9376b3eb26d8af94a86fc4f325e7ee/2704/after-spiral.png) | ![After: 3D Pocket Passes tab under Adaptive with Method set to Trochoidal and hint tooltip](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/871b8c1fec9376b3eb26d8af94a86fc4f325e7ee/2704/after-trochoidal.png) |

## Cause

This is new work, not a defect. #1509 gave the Method choice to 2D Adaptive only. #1587 added the multi-lane planner that a 3D level area needs.

## Tests (pins, mutation results)

New pins:

- `crates/motion/tests/pocket3d_troch.rs`
  - `each_level_is_cleared_by_loops_inside_its_own_level_area`
  - `no_rapid_ends_under_the_top_the_run_proved_cleared`
  - `a_level_the_method_cannot_cut_is_cut_by_the_spiral_plan_and_said`
  - `a_fallback_level_under_a_fallback_level_still_enters_from_the_stock_top`
  - `a_strategy_that_is_not_adaptive_reads_no_method`
- `crates/motion/src/machining3d/troch_tests.rs`
  - `a_bore_starts_on_a_plane_only_where_its_disc_is_proved_cleared`
  - `a_refused_level_posts_nothing_and_is_said_with_its_z`
  - `the_method_is_off_for_spiral_another_strategy_and_a_run_that_is_not_plain`
- `crates/motion/src/machining2d/adaptive_troch_level_tests.rs`
  - `a_level_inside_its_area_that_crosses_nothing_passes`
  - `a_cut_outside_the_level_area_is_refused_by_name`
  - `a_cut_across_an_earlier_move_is_refused_by_name`
- `crates/app/tests/pocket3d_trochoid.rs`
  - `the_trochoidal_method_stays_in_the_pocket_posts_clean_and_matches_its_golden`
  - `the_spiral_default_cuts_what_it_cut_and_another_strategy_reads_no_method`
  - `the_method_is_an_undoable_parameter_edit`
  - `a_new_3d_pocket_is_spiral_and_an_older_file_reads_as_spiral`
  - `mcp_sets_the_method_generates_verifies_and_refuses_an_unknown_word`
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/adaptive3d_method.rs`
  - `the_3d_adaptive_passes_tab_offers_the_method_and_defaults_to_spiral`
  - `a_strategy_that_reads_no_method_has_no_method_row`

Red before the change: the new suites do not compile on the base, because `pocket3d_trochoidal` and the field `method` do not exist.

The first run of the motion pin found a real defect in the first draft. The verifier reported `Crossing` between the bore helix of the upper level and the bore helix of the lower level. The fix: a proved bore starts on the proved plane, and each level is checked against all moves before it.

Mutations (each guard was broken, its pin was run, then the code was restored):

| Mutation | Pin | Result |
|---|---|---|
| M1: the cleared-disc proof accepts each level | `a_bore_starts_on_a_plane_only_where_its_disc_is_proved_cleared` | red |
| M2: the ladder does not reset the plane above | `a_fallback_level_under_a_fallback_level_still_enters_from_the_stock_top` | red |
| M3: the crossing check reads only the level's own moves | `a_cut_across_an_earlier_move_is_refused_by_name` | red |
| M4: the level-area check is off | `a_cut_outside_the_level_area_is_refused_by_name` | red |
| M5: a refused level is reported as posted | `a_refused_level_posts_nothing_and_is_said_with_its_z` | red |
| M6: a proved bore starts one plunge height above the plane | `a_bore_starts_on_a_plane_only_where_its_disc_is_proved_cleared` | red |
| M7: the generator does not dispatch to the method | `the_trochoidal_method_stays_in_the_pocket_posts_clean_and_matches_its_golden`, `mcp_sets_the_method_generates_verifies_and_refuses_an_unknown_word` | red |
| M8: the stamp does not read the method | `the_trochoidal_method_stays_in_the_pocket_posts_clean_and_matches_its_golden` | red |
| M9: the page does not draw the Method row | `the_3d_adaptive_passes_tab_offers_the_method_and_defaults_to_spiral` | red |

All pins are green on the final code.

Gate: `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` is green: 684 steps, 0 failed, 66.3 min wall. `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` is clean. The compile cache was off for these runs, because the sccache server on the machine did not answer.

## Goldens moved

None moved. One golden is new: `crates/app/tests/golden/pocket3d_trochoidal_pocket.cl` (1025 lines, 1023 moves). A second run without `WRITE_GOLDEN` matched it.

`git diff --stat upstream/main -- "*.nc" "*.cl"` lists this one new file and no changed file.

## Not exercised

- A real part with many levels. The pins use two and three levels of box models.
- Method = Trochoidal together with "Do not touch" items (#2149). The code passes the items to the same ladder, but no test has such an item.
- Method = Trochoidal with Rest roughing through the application. The motion entry point accepts it; no pin runs it.
- A re-machining mask from an earlier operation together with the method.
- Posted G-code was not compared with a golden `.nc`. The application test posts the setup and checks that the post succeeds.
- The engagement that the loops meet where an upper level left stock. A note gives the area that each level leaves.
- Platforms other than Linux x86-64.
- The four trochoidal controls of 2D Adaptive (#1588) are not on the 3D page. The 3D method uses their defaults. See `docs/decisions/1591-adaptive3d-trochoidal.md`.

`crates/motion/src/machining3d/ladder.rs` was 434 lines on #2149 and is 448 lines now. It was above the 400-line limit before this change. This change does not split it, because #2149 changes the same function.

## Overlaps

- #2149 changes `ladder` in `crates/motion/src/machining3d/ladder.rs` and the entry points in `entry.rs`. This branch starts from the head of #2149 (`39e6c84e8`).
- #2678 is stacked on #2149 and changes `ladder.rs`, `machining3d/mod.rs` and `machining2d/mod.rs` too. It touches the same file, different lines; whichever merges second refreshes.
- #1713 touches `kinds.rs`, `types/params.rs`, `project/params.rs`, `params_impl.rs`, `params/mill3d.rs` and `mill3d_page.rs` for `Finish3D`. It touches the same files, different functions; whichever merges second refreshes.
- #2659 and #2667 add lines to `crates/motion/src/machining2d/mod.rs`. Same file, different lines.
- #2666 and #2675 touch other arms of `generate.rs`.

Changelog: 3D Pocket: the Adaptive strategy has a Method choice (Spiral or Trochoidal); Trochoidal clears each level with trochoidal loops inside the level area, and a level that it cannot cut is cut by the Spiral plan and named.

Effort: max

Fixes #1591
